title: Eleven Miles and One Border
subtitle: 国家与乡土 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家与乡土（社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家与乡土（社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：country　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 country 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 my great-uncle ① left a country he had not been outside of in eleven years, and he said the leaving was the whole of the journey. The ② country, meaning the nation and not the land, took one stamp to leave and stayed that size in the mind; country, he said, is the only thing in a passport that is judged by how much of it travels with you.

Every ③ country in that atlas had the same green border, and the ④ country at the end, meaning the one he never reached and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever circled twice. Country, my grandmother said, is nine parts border and one part somebody willing to leave; my great-uncle said the leaving is the part that fills the passport.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the country was the whole of the walk, meaning the open land and not the nation. The ⑥ country, meaning the open land and not any of that, is the only thing in a walk that everybody praises and nobody farms; country, she said, is either something you leave or the only word that means both a nation and an open land. He said the open land is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ country had become a line in a form, and the form had become an argument about the border. The ⑧ country of the whole thing, my great-uncle wrote in April, was one stamp and thirty years of leaving; country, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to leave. She said the leaving was never mentioned.

The ⑨ country I remember is the one at the end, which he reached in 1972 and is still described as the greenest in the atlas. A ⑩ country, my grandmother said in 1974, is the only thing that improves by being left; every country, she said, is an open land that has agreed to look like a nation. She said the open land was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 国家（指那个国家本身，与那片土地相对）
C. 固定搭配：leave a country 离开一个国家
D. n. 国家（指那本地图册里每一个）
E. n. 国家（指末尾那一个）
F. n. 乡村；田野（与城市相对的乡野）
G. n. 国家（指表格里提到的那一个）
H. n. 国土；乡邦（抽象总称）

items.q: left a country he had not been outside of in eleven years
The country, meaning the nation and not the land
the country was the whole of the walk
The country, meaning the open land
the country had become a line in a form
The country of the whole thing
A country, my grandmother said in 1974

answers.why: leave a country 意为“离开一个国家”，1958 年姑祖父离开了一个他十一年没有出境的国家。
country 意为“国家”，指那个国家本身而不是那片土地，离开只需一张邮票。
country 指那本地图册里每一个国家，每一个都画着同样的绿色边界。
country 指末尾那一个（他从未到达的那一个），是唯一有人圈过两次的。
country 意为“乡村、田野”，母亲说乡野就是那次步行的全部，指的是开阔的田野而不是那个国家。
country 为另一个义项，指开阔的乡野而不是那个国家，是步行里人人都称赞、却无人耕种的东西。
country 意为“国家”，指表格里提到的那一个，到 1966 年这个国家成了表格里的一行。
country 意为“国土、乡邦”，姑祖父四月写道，整件事的乡邦是一张邮票三十年的离开。
country 意为“国家”，我记得的是末尾那一个，他 1972 年抵达，至今仍被说成地图册里最绿的。
country 为抽象总称，祖母说一个国家是唯一会因为被离开而变好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1958 年姑祖父离开了一个他十一年没有出境的国家，他说离开才是这整个旅程的全部。（leave a country）
那个国家，指的是那个国家本身而不是那片土地，离开只需一张邮票，并且在心里一直是那个大小。（country）
那本地图册里每一个国家都画着同样的绿色边界。（country）
末尾那一个国家，指的是他从未到达的那一个，是唯一有人圈过两次的。（country）
母亲说乡野就是那次步行的全部，指的是开阔的田野而不是那个国家。（country）
1974 年祖母说，一个国家是唯一会因为被离开而变好的东西。（country）
answers: In 1958 my great-uncle left a country he had not been outside of in eleven years, and he said the leaving was the whole of the journey.
The country, meaning the nation and not the land, took one stamp to leave and stayed that size in the mind.
Every country in that atlas had the same green border.
The country at the end, meaning the one he never reached and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever circled twice.
My mother said the country was the whole of the walk, meaning the open land and not the nation.
A country, my grandmother said in 1974, is the only thing that improves by being left.
